purpose: Define immutable responsibility boundaries between GitHub, scheduled ChatGPT runtime, and interactive user chats so implementation fixes cannot silently move control-plane logic between components.

precedence.rule: When deciding which component should perform a step, this ownership contract must be checked before temporary task state, automation prompts, workflow implementation details, logs, batch files, or prior chat conclusions.

responsibilities: define canonical business and execution rules
collect every source GitHub can access directly
compute deterministic transformations
decide the exact current production scope
construct manifests and explicit runtime work inputs
decide ordering and identity of items requiring external runtime facts
durably pin the exact Taste semantic work-unit and immutable profile identity in Git before semantic execution
require returned Taste results to bind to the exact pinned work-unit hash and pin authority commit
keep an in-flight pinned Taste work-unit authoritative even if the live profile advances later, while rejecting arbitrary historical results without that pre-semantic pin
retire, abandon, or replace a Taste work-unit pin only under canonical recovery/completion rules so the next work-unit freezes the then-current live profile
own retry state and unresolved-item state
own checkpoint merge logic and completeness accounting
validate all returned runtime facts against the exact prepared scope
persist validated canonical caches
decide whether the production cycle is complete
rebuild downstream history, deal, semantic-input and visual artifacts
fail closed when required inputs are incomplete
must_not_delegate: Taste work-unit pin creation or retirement authority

responsibilities: read canonical contracts and the explicit current work input prepared by GitHub
obtain facts that GitHub cannot obtain directly because of access or semantic limitations
return only the structured evidence/results required by the prepared input contract
perform required semantic judgments only where the canonical production contract explicitly assigns them to ChatGPT
preserve the exact GitHub-provided Taste work-unit/profile binding in returned semantic results
persist or submit results only through the repository-defined runtime artifact interface
forbidden: invent or redefine production scope
choose a new queue independently of GitHub
create, replace, or reinterpret Taste work-unit/profile pin authority
turn a checkpoint size into a quota
create an independent recurring production stage without a canonical contract change
replace GitHub retry/completeness logic with conversational iteration
change business rules while executing a production run
treat an interactive chat as the production scheduler or backlog manager
enable_disable_pause_delete_reschedule_or_edit_its_own_scheduled_task
scheduled_chatgpt_runtime_data_plane.steamdb_specific_rule: For SteamDB, ChatGPT may fetch exact external evidence for GitHub-prepared entity keys because GitHub Actions is blocked from SteamDB, but GitHub owns which keys are required, unresolved/retry state, completeness, validation, persistence into canonical history, and downstream orchestration.

interactive_chat.role: developer/operator session, not a production execution engine
allowed: change canonical contracts after verifying source-of-truth hierarchy
inspect bounded samples to verify an implementation
manually trigger or repair the canonical pipeline when supported

execute an explicitly user-authorized one-off Taste semantic throughput benchmark against exact GitHub-prepared and Git-durable pinned work-units, when the benchmark preserves GitHub-owned scope/order/pin/retry/ingest authority and persists every counted checkpoint through the canonical repository handoff before continuing
forbidden: manually process a large production backlog item by item as a substitute for repairing automation
create ad-hoc batch files that become a new production architecture without a canonical contract
continue manual data work after discovering that the intended automated component boundary is broken
declare a production defect fixed solely because partial manual data was accumulated
interactive_chat.sample_limit_rule: Manual evidence checks are normally permitted only as bounded verification of implementation behavior. A separately authorized one-off throughput benchmark is the sole exception: it may process successive GitHub-pinned semantic work-units only to measure factual interactive-run capacity, must use the canonical result/ingest path after every checkpoint, must not choose or reorder work, must not create a recurring producer, and must not be treated as normal production execution or as the future production limit.

one_off_taste_throughput_benchmark.authorization_source: WORKER_TASK_TASTE_NORMAL_SEMANTIC_PRODUCER_01.md when status is authorized_corrected_resume_chat_1 and mode is IMPLEMENT_AND_MEASURE_THROUGHPUT
one_off_taste_throughput_benchmark.rule: This exception authorizes semantic execution for measurement only. GitHub remains the control-plane owner for scope, order, pin authority, retry/completeness and canonical persistence. The interactive chat may evaluate only the exact current pinned work-unit, submit its structured result through the existing Taste inbox/ingest route, verify canonical acceptance, then continue with the next GitHub-prepared pin.

required_before_writes: identify the component whose responsibility is changing
name the canonical contract that authorizes that responsibility
verify the proposed change does not transfer a control-plane responsibility to ChatGPT or the interactive chat
verify the proposal does not create a new recurring stage, quota, queue, retry loop, or backlog manager without explicit canonical authorization
architecture_change_gate.user_correction_rule: A user correction is a high-priority signal to re-check canonical architecture, not permission to immediately implement the literal wording. First reconcile the correction with current contracts; if the contracts are ambiguous or wrong, fix the contracts before implementation.
architecture_change_gate.failure_rule: If ownership is ambiguous, stop implementation changes and resolve the ownership contract first. Do not patch symptoms by moving work into the current chat.

completion_definition.rule: A pipeline defect is fixed only when the intended owning component can perform the work automatically and the end-to-end validation succeeds. Manual backlog progress is evidence or temporary recovery data, not proof that the architecture is fixed. A one-off throughput benchmark measures capacity only and does not itself prove production architecture completeness or select a production limit.

github_responsibilities: derive current Deep eligibility from current Progressive semantic/work identity plus exact-compatible canonically accepted Dossier truth, without requiring prior Fast/PASS 1 attempt or analysis_incomplete
bind Deep work to semantic generation/work/appid/Dossier SHA/current Dossier compatibility binding and exact authorization identity
own normal first-pass scope/order, immutable result paths, and one normal first-pass attempt per current deep identity
own separate non-blocking recovery state, concrete recovery eligibility, recovery authorization identity and recovery attempt history
validate Deep result or terminal execution receipt and persist canonical Deep state
project explicit Fast/Dossier/Deep stage states plus effective-result provenance for read-only browser presentation
recompute Deep eligibility through the existing Progressive-owned entrypoint after canonical Dossier, Fast/PASS 1, daily binding/freshness and Deep attempt-state changes
keep normal Deep first-pass completeness separate from eventual all-current authoritative Deep completeness
scheduled_chatgpt_responsibilities_when_: read only GitHub-prepared current Deep/PASS 2 work
execute only exact authorized normal-first-pass or recovery items in GitHub order
publish only exact create-only result or terminal execution submission
never choose recovery reason, retry eligibility, queue scope, order, completeness, or scheduler settings

attempt_budget.recovery_requires: fresh explicit GitHub-owned authorization tied to a concrete recovery condition
allowed_recovery_conditions: corrected runtime/validation defect material to the prior failure
explicit canonical recovery action with recorded reason

forbidden: production semantic execution while Deep/PASS 2 active flags are false
ChatGPT scope selection, ordering, retry policy, recovery authorization, completeness or scheduler ownership
requiring Fast/PASS 1 attempt or Fast analysis_incomplete as the target Deep eligibility gate
treating Dossier buffer/unaccepted/failed candidate as accepted Deep evidence truth
mutating Fast/PASS 1 history to represent Deep output
blind automatic recovery retry loop or hidden arbitrary recovery quota
second independent scheduler or recurring Deep stage
